label: Q-02
title: [NARROWED] AutoAnnihilated gained two fields and the ABI break's 'free because nothing consumes it' premise is only partly verified
description: What survives is only what N32 does not say: (1) N32 addresses the FUNCTION SIGNATURE and says NOTHING about the AutoAnnihilated EVENT gaining two fields -- an indexer keyed on the old event topic breaks silently, with no revert to notice; (2) N32's 'free' premise is flagged by the KI re-extraction itself as 'a checkable factual claim about a sibling repo ... verify it rather than accept it'.
impact: Silent indexer breakage plus an unverified cross-repo premise. QA.
narrowing: The SIGNATURE half -- autoAnnihilate(address,uint256) -> autoAnnihilate(address) -- IS SUPPRESSED by N32, which documents it verbatim as 'a breaking ABI change, free because V2 is undeployed and phase-2-staging has no V2 deploy script'. Only the residue is filed.

verificationScope.verified: IN-REPO ONLY. src/interfaces, both migrators and src/versions were checked at cf8de27: no consumer.
verificationScope.ruling: Until checked, N32's 'free' premise is UNVERIFIED, not false. Routed as an obligation, never asserted as a defect.

crossRepoObligation.task: Confirm no V2 deploy script, script helper, test or indexer binds autoAnnihilate(address,uint256) or the old AutoAnnihilated event topic.

recommendation: Verify the phase-2-staging half of the premise; consider retaining the old event alongside the new one if any indexer binds it.
dedupNote: KEPT despite the partial N32 overlap -- dropping it would silently discard the unverified cross-repo premise (Law 1).
